name: Chongqing Fog City
author: silentoplayz (G30)
description: A river city of layered neon towers drifts past in mist and mirrors onto the water, dimmed and lowered behind the chat. Amber, magenta and cyan windows over cool fog grey, dark blue-grey at night, true black on OLED, pale mist in Light and a warm lantern haze in Her.
